name: Garlic Butter Ground Turkey with Cauliflower Skillet
why: All ground-turkey, one-skillet stovetop dish (no bakes) squarely in-lane. Site card publishes 415 cal/serving and a Low Carb badge; structurally low-carb (ground turkey + cauliflower florets + butter + soy/sriracha pan sauce, zero rice/pasta/potato/bean/bread) so ~12g carb estimate is safe under the 35g ceiling. Sits mid-low in the 400-650 band. Every ingredient maps cleanly to the Omaha board (ground-turkey, cauliflower, butter, minced-garlic, onion-powder, soy-sauce, hot-sauce, sesame-oil, cilantro, lemon-juice) - a clean pricer case. Scales fine to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide.
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60ml) low-sodium soy sauce (or coconut amino, for Paleo)
2 tablespoons hot sauce (Sriracha used in recipe)
nutrition_note: Calories (415) and 'Low Carb' label are from eatwell101's recipe card; the page's beta nutrition table does not publish a numeric carb value, so src_carbs is a structural estimate. Confidence on calories: medium-high; on exact carbs: structural (high that it is <35g).
